name: Founder decision: Ratify the placement of the four named bought tools with their refusals and confirm items, and hold one against canon
text_content:
P12, P13, and P14. Google Workspace carries the written surfaces pending the OS surface (the team home, the person page, the brief's block and record, the close's capture form, the channel if any), configuration where a page or form serves and a build where the write rules, language versions, record marks, or the capture's time cost cannot be met, never named as the hub and never the operating system by being where the pages are. Nectar is read as the carrier of the record's peer recognition platform, inferred and to confirm, and runs only with points, rewards, rankings, per-person counts, a manager's praise class, surveys, values scorecards, off-shift prompts, and any export to a review disabled; if it cannot, recognition runs as a fielded form read at the brief. Canny is read as the carrier of the record's structured feedback channel, inferred and to confirm, running Session 4's loop window on every item regardless of votes, refusing a person as a subject, a survey, a rating, a vote as order, anonymity by default, and closure without a reason, with its sync to the unnamed hub recorded as manual until the mesh carries it. Slang AI enters only where a call becomes a note on the book, a readiness block item, or a capture, never a relay by voice, and is held against canon per A6. Neither Nectar nor Canny is the pulse's carrier. Every unconfirmed item is recorded on the partners' page as manual. Blocks I6, I7, I8, rows 134 to 136. High.
